title: Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 provides for maintenance pendente lite and expenses of the proceeding

content.overview: Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 provides for maintenance pendente lite and expenses of the proceeding. Where either the wife or the husband has no independent income sufficient for support and the necessary expenses of the proceeding, the Court may order the other spouse to pay the expenses of the proceeding and a monthly sum during the proceeding, having regard to the incomes of both parties. The application is to be disposed of, as far as possible, within sixty days of service of notice.
